name: AWS — Kali / Penetration-Testing AMI Launched
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = amazon_aws_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "RunInstances"
| filter xdm.event.description contains "kali" or xdm.event.description contains "Kali" or xdm.event.description contains "parrot" or xdm.event.description contains "blackarch" or xdm.event.description contains "pentoo" or xdm.event.description contains "caine" or xdm.event.description contains "remnux" or xdm.event.description contains "santoku" or xdm.event.description contains "samurai" or xdm.event.description contains "ami-01b4cff60c681b957" or xdm.event.description contains "ami-0d52e51e479a0e69e" or xdm.event.description contains "t3.medium"
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as kali_launches,
       values(xdm.source.user.username) as users,
       values(xdm.event.description) as events_seen
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, users, events_seen
description: RunInstances event referencing a known Kali Linux, Parrot, BlackArch, Pentoo, or similar offensive-security AMI ID, or a t3.medium pentest-pattern instance type.
